description_en: Extends the wait time for an ECS instance that is suspended after a lifecycle hook is triggered
description_zh: 延长一个生命周期挂钩触发后被挂起的ECS实例的等待时间
kebab_example: aliyun ess record-lifecycle-action-heartbeat --lifecycle-hook-id ash-bp1fxuqyi98w0aib0000 --lifecycle-action-token F324B880-900E-4968-85DD-816911130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lifecycle hook
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that indicates the wait state of the scaling activity. You can obtain this token from the details of the message received from the Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) queue specified by the lifecycle hook when the instance is in the suspended state.

You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202473.html to obtain this token.

Alternatively, you can obtain this value from the Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) topic specified by the lifecycle hook
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动的等待状态标识符，您可以在实例被挂起的状态下，从生命周期挂钩指定的MNS队列中，接收消息对应的详情页中获取。

也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202473.html获取。

还可以从生命周期挂钩指定的MNS主题中获取该值
parameters.name: lifecycle_action_token

parameters.help_en:
The wait time that the lifecycle hook sets for the scaling group activity. After the wait state times out, the default policy is executed. Valid values: 30 to 21600. Unit: seconds.

After a lifecycle hook is created, you can call this operation to extend the wait time of the ECS instance, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73847.html to end the wait state of the scaling activity in advance.

Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩为伸缩组活动设置的等待时间，等待状态超时后会执行默认执行策略。取值范围：30~21600，单位：秒。

创建了生命周期挂钩后，您可以调用本接口延长ECS实例的等待时间，也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73847.html提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态。

默认值：600
parameters.name: heartbeat_timeout

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id
